notes.title: Official HD Launch - 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Howdy Scramblers,

The HD Update is now available by default for all players!

Previously available for public beta, this version includes a higher max resolution, better fullscreen scaling, and sharper fonts.

Thanks for your continued support.

Skeletons, Advance!

notes.title: HD Update Beta Release
notes.notes:
Howdy Scramblers!

The HD Update for Skeleton Scramble Deluxe is now available for beta! You can opt-in via the properties menu in your Steam client today.

Previously, the game played in 480p, which was scaled to your screen size. In the new update, the game is playable at 1440p, with multiple scaling options in the settings menu.

Fonts will no longer be blurry at high resolutions, (a common complaint.)

Although the "play area" is still in 4:3, the screen will expand to 16:9 in fullscreen mode.

Thanks for your continued support.

[b]Skeletons, Advance![/b]

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 Release
notes.notes:
Bug Fix!

Starting a Gauntlet run will automatically revert the player two control scheme to "CPU".

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Release
notes.notes:
Bug Fix!

In the previous build, returning to the main menu during the tutorial would lock the game in a permanent tutorial state. This is fixed!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Bug Fix!

For some reason, your initial save game has 10 recorded wins in the gauntlet mode. Version 1.1.0 resolves this and wipes your existing gauntlet attempt/win stats.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Release
notes.notes:
Bug Fix!

In version 1.0.0, the Undying Bot would sometimes summon a ghost with the intention of ghost-boosting, and then attempt to flee an incoming forest giant before sacrificing the ghost. This causes the ghost to fly offscreen, leaving the Undying Bot unable to move or build structures. This has been fixed in the latest version.

Thanks for playing!
